description:
Welcome to Lulu Harris Candles, where passion, artistry, and quality come together to create candles that illuminate more than just your space—they tell a story.

What started as a small hobby of making candles for fun quickly turned into a full-fledged passion for creating beautiful, sculptural pieces that stand out from the ordinary. We believe that candles should be more than just a source of light; they should be a work of art, a centerpiece that transforms your space.

Our Journey
It all began in our cozy home kitchen, experimenting with different waxes, scents, and shapes, simply for the joy of it. We soon realized that this hobby sparked a deeper love for creating unique candles that are as beautiful as they are functional. After sharing our handmade creations with friends and family, we decided to turn this passion into a small business, offering candles that elevate the ambiance of any space.

Our Commitment to Natural Ingredients
At Lulu Harris Candles, we prioritize using natural wax over paraffin for a cleaner and healthier burn. We craft each candle with 100% natural soy wax ensuring an eco-friendly product that’s free from harmful chemicals. Unlike paraffin, which can release toxic fumes when burned, our natural wax candles offer a clean, long-lasting burn that you can feel good about using in your home. Not only are our candles better for the environment, but they also create a warmer, more inviting glow.

Our Mission: Sculptural Candles, Not Just Plain Wax
Our mission is to turn candles into sculptural pieces that add character and style to your space.

We design every candle with the intention of making it a statement piece, not just another plain item to blend into the background. Whether it’s a unique geometric shape, a floral-inspired design, or a candle that resembles a piece of modern art, our creations are meant to captivate and inspire.

Each candle is meticulously crafted by hand, combining art and fragrance to create something truly special.

Why Choose Us?
• Handcrafted with Care: Each candle is hand-poured in small batches, ensuring quality and attention to detail.
• Eco-Friendly and Sustainable: Our natural wax candles are biodegradable, cruelty-free, and free from toxins.
• Artistic Designs: We believe that candles should be as beautiful as they are functional, adding a touch of artistry to your home decor.

Light up your space with a candle that’s anything but ordinary. Explore our collection and find your new favorite sculptural piece that lights up your life, both literally and aesthetically.

Payment Terms: payment in arrears 30 days from end of month
